description_for_human: UK area intelligence: signals, scores, monitoring, and natural-language answers for any UK postcode.
description_for_model: Deterministic UK area-intelligence API. Score any UK postcode for an intent (moving, business, investing, research) across seven categories (safety and crime, deprivation, property, schools, amenities, transport, environment); pull raw signals with named public sources; compare, find, and monitor areas. Every response is stamped with the engine version and is reproducible. Also available as a Model Context Protocol server. A full index is at https://www.onegoodarea.com/llms.txt and the complete reference at https://www.onegoodarea.com/llms-full.txt.
